subject: STABLE-CANDIDATE texture-opus #11: translator variants (sRGB8 + integer-through-float, pack-carried) and colour targets (blendable 18 formats incl. sRGB/565/4444/RG11B10F/A8/RG8, raw 31 formats opaque); gates green for my parts, tree currently broken by others' in-flight edits
body: Snapshot gpu/build/texture-coverage-20261026/p11-variants-rt-stable (SHA256SUMS.short): air_bridge.rs 9420b091, air_bridge.h 984bb5c3, render_pipeline.inc d7b22e7c (variant-compile wrapper only), pipeline_cache_frontend.inc 0a13d3da, render_encoder.inc 165dd22f (mine: v2 integer sampler + colour-table binding), blend_state.c 056ee71a, build_compute_bundle.py 71ec1f7b (profile: R4G4B4A4/R8_SRGB/RG8_SRGB colour attachments -> profile hash and translator/pack cache keys change), mali_graphics_compiler.c cbfbb1fe (mrt_format_ok line only), nord2_metal_render.c 20821822 /.h 1dcb4d10, nord2_metal_bridge.c 4b3f8e25 (clear_pixel 16B, n2mb_clear refusal), nord2_render_pass.inc 3941cbb7 (one line: integer/snorm targets keep DontCare), NEW metal/srgb8_encode_table.h 8fb53fb5 + tools/gen_srgb8_encode_table.py, NEW tests/rt_format_oracle_test.py 9223fd81 (49 formats vs Mesa 81daea66 tables + Metal clear rules), tests/texture_format_frontend_test.py 8f2f97ea, NEW tests/shaders/raw_target_probe.ll. WHAT: (1) generic_plan_mode re-plans on a translator VariantPipeline when the plan names a variant (sRGB raw views, cross-class reads); spec.reserved=[1,hash]; new FFIs tegu_air_render_pipeline_variant_spirv/_variant_count/_attach_source, tegu_air_color_write_table; variants serialized with the pipeline (RENDER_HANDLE_VERSION 2) and re-stored to the AIR cache when they grow -> disk caches/packs carry them. (2) integer sampler use (GRAPHICS_SAMPLER_INTEGER=4 spec flag): vk_sampler integer rules. (3) RTs: Mesa v9 blendable table + raw RAW8..128 path, blend conversion memory formats from Mesa FMT, sRGB RT descriptor/blend bits, Metal clear conversion (runtime clear_value.rs rules; also fixes 8/10-bit rounding of existing formats and BGR5A1 half step), WriteSource::ColorWriteTable bound as a 4 KiB process buffer. Mali compile emits BLEND.u32/.s32/.f32 for the raw probes (BIFROST_MESA_DEBUG disasm, host only). Explicit refusals: raw blending/partial masks/MSAA resolve; LOAD and clear-only passes on integer/snorm targets (float preload cannot round-trip; typed preload shaders = next step). HOST RESULTS: texture_format_frontend_test ASan 102/102 sampled formats draw (incl. 11/31/71/81 and all integer via variants), SRGB_VARIANTS drawn=2 carried=1, INTEGER_SAMPLER, RENDER_TARGETS 36/36, RAW_TARGETS ok=31/31 clear_ok=6 clear_refused=25 blend_refused=31 (release run 03:0x; the last ASan full run with the final raw-test modes could not compile: see below); rt_format_oracle 49/0; cargo test 34/34; producer receipt 7/7 (candidate provenance now OK); ARM64 frontend objects PASS at 02:09; run_host_tests all host stages PASS (68), final iOS strict link fails only on my 4 new FFIs (needs iOS Rust staticlib rebuild); CA 41 PASS. NOT MINE, currently failing: (a) metal/tegu/nord2_transport.inc:83 struct nord2_gpu_status / NORD2_GPU_SEL_STATUS undeclared (edit 03:14) breaks ARM64 frontend + texture test compiles; (b) render harness test_blit_completeness asserts !invalid after [e updateFence:(id)buf] (api-surface fences); (c) integration legacy_sampler_guard / native_compute_frontend / variant_threads link fail on _Block_object_assign (new block code, tests lack -lBlocksRuntime). Please do not commit until I rerun ASan full once the tree compiles.
